items.text: Schwab states it maintains its competitive position in Advisor Services through sales, support, technology, and business consulting teams dedicated to helping RIAs grow, compete, and succeed, with a focus on superior service and technology providing a scalable platform.
items.quote: Management believes that we can maintain our competitive position primarily through the efforts of our sales, support, technology, and business consulting teams, which are dedicated to helping RIAs grow, compete, and succeed in serving their clients. In addition to focusing on superior service, we utilize technology to provide RIAs with a highly-developed, scalable platform

items.text: Schwab states its advisor business is built around helping independent advisors grow, compete and succeed, and that the business requires scale, trust, operational excellence, outstanding service and breadth.
items.quote: We have built our adviser business around helping independent advisers grow, compete and succeed... This business requires scale, trust, operational excellence, outstanding service and the breadth to support advisers as their businesses and their clients' needs become more complex.

items.text: Schwab states it is deepening relationships with RIA firms by building a broader support ecosystem that extends beyond custody alone, including grown lending support, alternatives capability, and an expanded institutional no-transaction-fee mutual fund platform.
items.quote: we're deepening relationships with the 16,000 RIA firms we serve by building a broader support ecosystem that extends beyond custody alone to add value for RIAs. We've grown our lending support, alternatives capability, and expanded our institutional no-transaction fee mutual fund platform

items.quote: The leading RIA support ecosystem to help advisors serve their clients, providing wealth tools, investment / lending products, & technology in addition to custody & service

items.text: Schwab states that in advisor services it is adding support and capabilities for RIAs of all sizes while helping new advisors transition to independence.
items.quote: In advisor services, we are adding support and capabilities for RIAs of all sizes while also helping new advisors transition to independence.

items.text: Schwab states focus areas for its custody offerings include lending (pledged-asset lines), private-market investing, and long-short investment strategies, and playing the role of being RIAs' bank to help them manage both sides of clients' balance sheets.
items.quote: Wurster cited the growing use of pledged-asset lending balances, the demand for long-short investment strategies, and the need to make private-market investing more accessible to the masses as focus areas for its custody offerings. ... 'We are increasingly trying to play a role of being their bank and helping them manage both sides of the balance sheet for their clients.'

items.text: Schwab states it will continue to focus on custody services for RIAs with under $100 million AUM, and that its role is to provide a platform and support ecosystem to help advisors support clients and thrive.
items.quote: Schwab will continue to focus on its custody services for registered investment advisors with under $100 million AUM... 'Our job and our role is to provide a platform and a support ecosystem that helps you support your clients and helps your firm thrive.'

items.text: Schwab states it has rounded out its offering to advisors by adding more lending capabilities, including a structured asset lending program enabling clients to borrow against alternative and restricted/private shares.
items.quote: We've rounded out our offering to them in terms of adding more lending capabilities... recently launched a structured asset lending program, which has opened up advisers' ability to have their clients borrow against alternative investments, borrow against their restricted shares, private shares

items.text: Schwab states, as the largest custodian for advisors, it is focused on creating long-term value and access for advisors and on investing in innovation, capabilities, and service to help advisors grow and investors succeed.
items.quote: Schwab is focused on creating long-term value and access for advisors and retail investors... we remain focused on investing in innovation, capabilities, and service to help advisors grow and investors succeed.
